description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the 'Workouts' screen where users can log new workout sessions, including selecting workout type, duration, and notes. It interacts with application state to add new workouts.

classes.name: WorkoutsScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the workouts logging screen.

classes.name: _WorkoutsScreenState
classes.description: The internal state for WorkoutsScreen, managing user input and interactions.

methods.name: _logWorkout
methods.description: Creates a Workout object with current input and updates application state to add the new workout, then resets input fields and shows success message.
